description: Every form of zhang's budget directives (see main.zhang and budgets.zhang): what they define and do, how zhang and beancount write them, and that writing and reading them again changes no answer.

requests.bql: SELECT name, meta('owner') AS owner, meta('alias') AS alias FROM #budget_definitions

known_issues.round_trip.beancount: KNOWN-ISSUE: a budget directive with a time is written to beancount with its date and time (`2024-02-15 18:00:00 custom "budget-close" "Fun"`), which zhang's beancount parser cannot read, so the round trip does not load, and which bean-check 3.2.3 rejects (`syntax error, unexpected NUMBER`); other directives move their time into a `time` metadata entry (extensions/beancount/src/lib.rs:163-169)
known_issues.export: KNOWN-ISSUE: a `budget` metadata entry written unquoted in zhang (`budget: Groceries`, the form the budget docs show) is written unquoted to beancount too, which bean-check 3.2.3 rejects (`Invalid token`); zhang's own beancount parser reads it
